rationale: Off-season US. Last observed week (2026-08-22) = 795, provisional and a floor (late reports revise upward). No FluSight hub submission this week (off-season), so no ensemble to beat. Anchor = gbt, the best backtested method (MAE h3 60, beats flat), medians 798/824/977 for h1-h3. I nudged centers modestly above gbt toward the seasonal method (918/976/1104) because both admissions (620→677→795, +17% last wk) and ILI (+8% last wk) show a mild early-fall uptick consistent with school-reopening seeding, and the last point is a floor. h0 centered at 810 to reflect expected upward revision of the provisional 795. Intervals widened with horizon and to cover the gbt-vs-seasonal method disagreement (1.27x at h1 to 1.48x at h3) plus inflection risk as the season could turn faster than it looks; h3 95% spans ~700-1550 (factor ~2.2). Would revise up if ILI keeps climbing past ~1.2% or a dominant H3N2 subclade emerges; would revise down if the uptick reverts to the ~650 summer baseline.
